data.narrative:
Jimmy Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Antoine Guyot and Mathilde Grivet, having raised €80M to date. The valuation analysis relies on a comp universe of 11 peers across the nuclear energy sector—3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Valar Atomics, Helion, Oklo, X-Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression, using the €80M raised as a valuation proxy, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $160M. Peer-Median analysis across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Valar Atomics (Series B, $6.0B), Nano Nuclear Energy (Seed, $808M), and Fuse Energy (Series A, $200M)—yields a median valuation of $808M, with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $136M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $484M across both methods. The wide dispersion reflects material stage and maturity heterogeneity within the peer set, particularly the $6.0B outlier (Valar Atomics, Series B). Key uncertainties center on Jimmy Energy's capital intensity trajectory, technology differentiation relative to Fuse Energy (direct Series A peer at $200M), and whether near-term funding patterns will more closely track stage-progression mechanics or peer multiples.
